verdict.reasons: Image clearly displays the required white and blue AFP drip-tape roll with legible and authentic branding ('Drip Irrigation Tape', water-drop logo, Persian text). The installed black drip line and neutral seedlings correctly support the article's 'agronomy' intent regarding drip-tape installation. Product geometry and proportions are realistic. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present and correct. No wrong products, people, mixed families, or layout issues found.

focused_physical_review.reason: Visual inspection of the full frame shows the white-and-blue AFP package on the soil. A white flat ribbon or strip clearly emerges from the right side of the carton, extending across the soil to the right; this constitutes package_has_protruding_strip=true. The same white strip appears to interact with the adjacent black irrigation line (running parallel behind/beside it) and touches/crosses the package footprint region at the base/side, so line_touches_or_crosses_package=true. Because the strip and the black line break the continuous soil boundary around the package base (especially on the right side), a broad uninterrupted gap around the complete footprint is not visible, so clear_soil_gap=false. No distinct additional loose roll or uninstalled coil is visible separate from the required package (the required roll itself is not counted as extra), so extra_loose_product_coil=false.
